item.description:

Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty is defining an ionic field strength disparity coefficient (η) to quantify local chemical-field heterogeneity and guide compensatory cation doping. This lowers η, reducing lattice strain and enhancing structural reversibility. Significance: the low-η cathode retains over 80% capacity after 500 cycles at 10C versus 22% for the unmodified counterpart, offering a quantitative descriptor for dopant selection and a general strategy for stable high-voltage sodium-ion cathodes.
